# Anubhav Gain

Security Software Engineer · Infopercept · Mumbai, India

Anubhav Gain (mranv) is a security software engineer in Mumbai, India. Since July 2024 he has worked at Infopercept, building the Invinsense XDR deployment architecture and Invinsense Unified Endpoint Control, and has consulted on endpoint security at Mahindra Finance and application security at SBI Life.

Before that he was a DevSecOps engineer at Atcults (November 2023 to July 2024) and an IT security specialist at Parul University (November 2022 to October 2023). He holds a B.Tech in Cyber/Computer Forensics and Counterterrorism from Parul University (2021–2025) and two 2023 licentiates from Charles Sturt University, in Ransomware Techniques and Cybersecurity Management.

He maintains open-source security tools in Rust, Go and Python, including Leviathan, Atomic Prevention, Agni, Krustron and eBPF File Monitor, writes field notes on application control and detection engineering, and founded Gain Fisheries, a fish hatchery in Pakhanjur, Chhattisgarh, in 2020.

Open the editor for the full work log, project screenshots, stack and contribution calendar.
